title: General W4 shifted-inverse Schur recovery
statement: For every admissible real unit-diagonal SPD child C and every admissible fourth-coordinate Schur extension, the anisotropic L3 child surplus proves the documented W4 shifted-inverse recovery inequality, or an explicitly stated aggregate replacement strong enough for that single W4 induction edge.
assumptions: The normalized spectral floor and Schur-extension admissibility are those fixed in the iteration-6 Bellman state
An aggregate replacement must prove the same one-step W4 induction edge, not merely structured slices
open_objections: Only matching, weighted-three-path, and equal-star slices are currently established.
Even a proof of this W4 edge leaves stable propagation through all later depths open.
No hostile audit, independent reconstruction, priority audit, or formal validation exists for the general statement.
